page_title: AUS 1-0 DEN | Australia v Denmark 30/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
90+5' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is about to take a corner kick.
90+5' Kasper Dolberg (Denmark) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mathew Ryan makes a great save.
90+4' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Mathew Ryan has no trouble gathering it.
90+4' Robert Skov (Denmark) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Denmark will take a corner kick.
90+3' Alexander Bah (Denmark) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+2' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The foul by Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark) was seen by Mustapha Ghorbal who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
89' Here is a change. Mathew Leckie is going off and Graham Arnold gives the last tactical orders to Ajdin Hrustic (Australia).
88' Alexander Bah (Denmark) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post.
86' Keanu Baccus (Australia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
82' Substitution. Mitchell Duke makes way for Jamie Maclaren (Australia).
82' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' Alexander Bah (Denmark) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Australia.
77' Alexander Bah (Denmark) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
75' The foul by Robert Skov (Denmark) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mustapha Ghorbal.
74' Substitution. Riley McGree did his best and is replaced by Bailey Wright (Australia).
73' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) is penalised for a foul. Mustapha Ghorbal had a clear view and blows his whistle.
72' Kasper Dolberg (Denmark) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
69' Substitution. Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) replaces Joakim Maehle.
69' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Skov (Denmark) replacing Andreas Skov Olsen.
69' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post.
69' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

69' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Denmark force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' Aziz Behich (Australia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Denmark.
65' The resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Denmark) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

65' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Corner kick. Denmark will have an opportunity.

64' Jackson Irvine (Australia) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mathew Leckie, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Denmark.
60' 1 - 0 Mathew Leckie (Australia) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
59' Kasper Hjulmand prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark).
59' That's the end of the game for Martin Braithwaite, who is replaced by Kasper Dolberg (Denmark).
58' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) hits the free kick from the edge of the box, but can't find the target. His shot flies miles wide of the right post.
57' Mustapha Ghorbal shows a yellow card to Milos Degenek (Australia) for a tough tackle.
54' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Mathias Jensen (Denmark) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
53' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
48' Jackson Irvine (Australia) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
47' Aaron Mooy (Australia) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

47' Aziz Behich (Australia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee blows his whistle, Australia are awarded a corner kick.
46' Aaron Mooy (Australia) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexander Bah (Denmark) is coming onto the pitch as Rasmus Kristensen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' Graham Arnold decides to make a substitution. Craig Goodwin will be replaced by Keanu Baccus (Australia).
46' Referee Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Craig Goodwin (Australia). It's a throw-in for Australia.

45+1' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. There is a free kick near the sideline to Australia.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' A pass from Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) is intercepted by Mathew Ryan and the move breaks down.
42' Mitchell Duke (Australia) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Kasper Schmeichel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
40' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Andreas Skov Olsen. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Australia.
40' A lofted cross from Riley McGree (Australia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
38' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Christian Eriksen (Denmark), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
37' Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle. Mitchell Duke (Australia) commits a foul after dangerous play. Denmark are awarded the free kick.
35' Mathew Leckie (Australia) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Mustapha Ghorbal who sees an offensive foul.

32' Mitchell Duke (Australia)'s poor effort is easily saved by Kasper Schmeichel. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
29' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
29' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
25' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan made a easy save.
24' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Kasper Schmeichel blocks Riley McGree (Australia)'s effort from the edge of the box.
21' Denmark quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

21' The ball is cleared after Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Denmark will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Half-chance! Joakim Maehle (Denmark) plays a pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
18' Andreas Christensen (Denmark) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Mathias Jensen (Denmark) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
14' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
12' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

12' Mathias Jensen (Denmark) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Mathew Ryan shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
11' Craig Goodwin (Australia) attempts to find Mitchell Duke, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
10' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Aziz Behich (Australia) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Denmark will have a goal kick.
8' Craig Goodwin (Australia) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Aziz Behich. The ball is out of play. Denmark will have a throw-in.
7' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathew Ryan, who smothers the ball.
4' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
4' Aziz Behich (Australia) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' Riley McGree (Australia) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
1' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Denmark will take the kick-off.
Mustapha Ghorbal is the one to supervise the game today.
